comparison.objective: Open an anti-static bag, remove one battery, and place it upright in a holder; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Zipper-slider manipulation, bag access, selective extraction, and holder insertion versus fine hex access, collar tuning, socket reacquisition, and test actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one cell must be removed and correctly oriented in the holder while the other remains bagged, with arms returned. Candidate uses dynamic force, travel, rebound, and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Packaging access and selective component placement test different mechanics and outcomes.
